На изучение и закрепление фундаментальных знаний требуется колоссальное количество времени. Но, с коллективом 2.0 люди буквально смогут сократить весь этот слегка нудный (но нужный) процесс изучения основ до нескольких мгновений! Таким образом прогресс будет идти гораздо быстрее. Представьте себе ситуацию: человечество далеко продвинулось в абсолютно всех областях науки: математика, биология, химия. Чтобы объять весь объем полученных человечеством знаний какому-нибудь, хотя бы, 14-летнему ребенку, который практически НИЧЕГО не знает об устройстве этих наук( да и о мире особо тоже ничего), этому ребенку потребуется убить лет 20 на изучение и закрепление просто БАЗЫ в какой-то ОДНОЙ сфере науки, и только спустя 20 лет изучения основ можно будет делать какие-нибудь  РЕАЛЬНЫЕ и ПОЛЕЗНЫЕ вещи только в ЭТОЙ сфере науки. a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.

c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.

b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.

c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.

1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.

❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

Im sorry but the multiverse has just made a giant mess of the mcu. It's really annoying that actors we are familar with playing one character are returning as 4 other ones, when all we want to see is that original character again. If you are going to complete the story then stick with it, but the problem is that they killed off some of the most important characters prematurely without a good replacement to make the franchise feel grounded. They should have kept the multiverse mostly to the what if series and had the mcu go into the secret invasion where you could really bring back some actors as either the original character or skrulls. That would have been a far more acceptable use of actors. But now theres 5 versions of everybody, it's an exaggeration but you get the point. It's endless use of the same actors, while the original character they played is over shadowed. South Park was kind of right. It allows for lazy writing and cheap cop outs. It just makes a mess out of anything. I dont care so much about the mcu anymore. While Downey as Doom is a bit interesting, the timeline is such a mess at this point that none of the movies interest me because I ask myself, what's the point in getting invested when the movies lack a foundation that we can come back to.

#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...

a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.

b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.

I was a medium tier fan of Gorillaz. And had only listened to about half of their songs and that was enough to make me want to go to a concert. Turns out they came to Arizona so I bought foot tickets for just shy of 200$. They played so many songs including tomorrow comes today. But then Damon sat down at a piano. The stage went black and a spotlight lit him up. Then this song started. The first pass of the piano keys caught me off guard given it was my first time hearing it. Then a woman behind me pushed her way up between me and someone else and I go “my bad was I blocking your view?” Given I’m 6’2 and she seemed to be a foot shorter. She answered “yeah sorry it’s just that this is my favorite song and I really have to see him sing it” and so now she’s just in front of me and I’m listening to this song for the first time ever seeing her standing there with absolutely every fiber of her body trying to absorb the song as much as possible. Then the heat drops and everyone just goes wild. I mean the whole show was amazing and this was definitely one of the highlights. Eventually after the show she had turned around before I got a chance to leave and look for a friend I came with who got separated from me and asked for my number. We’ve been talking and she’s a cool person in the end. Hearing it live versus when I came home to listen to it again. It just, I’m glad hearing it In person was the first time I had heard it and it was definitely a beautiful experience:D

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.

c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.

a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.

b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.

У этой игры есть 4 части, но большая и включающая в себя не только поиски чего либо, потому заслуживающая больше внимания - это вторая. Интересна тем, что в ней повествуется о семье из отца и дочки, живущих приблизительно в 18 веке. В одну из ночей в трактире дочь главного героя неожиданно пропадает, и он разузнает у крестьян о расположенном неподалёку поместье почившего феодала, представляющего из себя громадный замок с катакомбами, где по легенде уже поселился некий Тонкий Человек (дословный перевод с англ. Slenderman, как Слендермена принято называть в этой игре). Довольно большая и крутая игруха, что для своего времени, что сейчас (не уверен, есть ли она сейчас в плей маркете, но в инете в apk точно должна быть), а так же о том, что дети уже пропадали в области, неподалеку от этого замка, потому все говорят о причастности к этим случаям именно Тонкого Человека, и гг в итоге отправляется туда. Действительно масштабные, громадные локации, чего стоят те же катакомбы, которые будут почти в самом начале игры. Ближе к финалу герой будет спускаться в поисках дочери глубоко под замок, в тамошние пещеры, а сам финал тоже получился крутым. Игра незаслуженно забытая, и я не знаю точно, можно ли её где-то найти и скачать, скорее всего да. (сам не пробовал). Если у кого-то появится желание пройти на мобиле, ооочень советую.

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.

b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.

My argument as to why this MV is a TIME TRAVELLING story.

Two funerals:
0:51 The funeral Ahn attended here is not the same as the funeral shown at 0:00 and 1:12 – the 0:51 funeral is Seo’s funeral in the present, the same funeral in 5:13. The funeral where we see Seo and Ahn interact at 0:00 and 5:38 is another funeral, both are alive at both times.

The Watch:
0:00 Seo’s watch is broken and froze at 10.11 symbolizing their first MV (Seo’s POV) while at 5:32 Ahn’s watch (given by Seo, it was Seo’s watch) shows 6.20 symbolizing this MV (Ahn’s POV) – the watch is ticking but Ahn STOPS IT and at 5:26 we see him again in the tunnel, without Seo. If we consider this MV is produced by Starship’s team which does a similar storyline about time-travelling in Monsta X’s The Connect album and Kiss or Death, you will see that watches are used as a time-travelling device. And as seen in Dramarama, STOPPING the ticking is how they travel back. And in Dramarama it also shows that a broken watch means they can no longer time-travel (aka Seo’s broken watch at 0:00).

They focused too much on the watch, the ticking, and stopping the ticking – it is a little suspicious.


The Train:
4:02 the ringing is heard and at 4:07 we see the train going to the RIGHT. At 5:28 the ringing and the ticking is heard, and the train at 5:33 can be seen going to the LEFT. In Monsta X’s Destroyer and Kiss and Death, train carries time travelers and seem to symbolize the flow of time – so if the theory that Starship indeed use Monsta X’s time travel universe in this MV, we can argue that train going to the right means time is moving forward while train going to the left means time moves backwards, aka Ahn time travel back to the past. And the tunnel can be some sort of time warp tunnel, because at 3:55 Seo seems anxious in the tunnel, like he knows the time is almost up. At 4:48 Seo is breathing frantically and looks very scared, and at 4:58 when he turns back after Ahn yells, he is so desperate to go to Ahn one very last time, but time is up.

5:08 Ahn sees Seo’s time warp effect right in front of his eyes. That’s how he knows about the time travelling thing.

Rules:
1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.
2: If you hear a security guard near you hide immediately.
3: Do not steal from a store, leave money on the counter.
4: You need to be asleep by 2am.


❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.


Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

Don't hitch your wagon to a singular character, but more so the concept can be picked up by another character that can be easily cast. Eleven is now forever solidified as MBB. (Curte pra ele ver) Não comentei porque achei que seria chato, mas como você agradeceu pelas noções de DBD, um fato importante: no DBD tudo ocorre em uma realidade paralela, e quem leva, tanto os monstros, quanto os sobreviventes para essa outra realidade é um ser conhecido como "Entidade". Ela se personifica nesse jogo e no DBD como uma nevoa negra e umas patas de aranha. No começo do jogo, por exemplo, a siderúrgica depois da morte do Frank fica vermelha e mostra patas de aranha em volta dela. Tendo essa noção, da pra especular até agora que ali seria um local de ligação com a entidade para o outro mundo, e que o Frank estaria tentando invoca-la ao matar todas aquelas pessoas, sendo a criança a última chave. O corpo dele provavelmente não foi achado porque a entidade levou ele para esse outro mundo, como um assassino. Na mesma lógica, o policial poderia ter sido levado como um sobrevivente caso tivesse morrido. Não se sabe as intenções da entidade, apenas que ela seleciona pessoas do nosso mundo e as leva para dela, onde o instinto assassino dos "monstros" são aflorados ainda mais, e os de sobrevivência das pessoas também. Vale adicionar por último que nem todo assassino do DBD é um psicopata em série, a única relação que todos tem em comum é o seu sofrimento em vida na terra. Alguns tiveram que matar pra sobreviver por serem considerados diferentes, o primeiro boneco por exemplo que você pegou, "O Caipira", nasceu com o rosto desfigurado e era visto como um monstro por todos, por isso foi maltratado e abusado pelas pessoas até ter que matar alguém para sobreviver, seus próprios pais. Com isso dá pra entender um pouco mais da ideia sombria desse universo de DBD e a relação que tem com a ideia de outras realidades, sobrevivência e sofrimento.

The problem with the Green Lantern movie was never the subject.  When something flops, money always takes home the lesson that the subject is therefore lacking.  But it's never the IP's fault.  Green Lantern is a guy with a magic ring.  Even Hal Jordan used the ring to do I Dream of Jeannie stuff until the late 60s. and even then would often call the green energy "mystic".It does no good to science fiction up a concept if you then insist on putting it all in the hands of magic wizards living in a world that LOOKS like magic wizards live there.  It's as simple as that.Oa needed to be a super scientific utopia.  It did not.  Add to that  a supremely wimpy portrayal of Jordan as a guy who quits just at the first setback, and you have a flick that crapped all over everything that made Green Lantern work.  So the movie failed.  And if you make another that uses GL as comedy relief, you will just make the problem of brand perception worse.Still, the true fault of failure lies with execution.  If they can make it work and work well, none of the above will matter.  And if we're being honest, every time I see more of this new Superman movie, I feel better than I did before about it.  So here's hoping.

A bent rim that gets straightened is almost never back to original factory strength. Metal fatigue is real. When the rim got hit hard enough to dent like that, the metal structure was already stressed and partially weakened at the microscopic level. Straightening it bends the metal again in the opposite direction, which adds more stress.How much weaker depends on the material and how bad the bend was.Steel rims usually survive repairs much better. They can often be straightened with relatively small strength loss if there are no cracks.Aluminum alloy rims are a different story. Aluminum work-hardens and becomes more brittle after deformation. A major bend repair can leave the area noticeably weaker and more prone to cracking later, especially from potholes or high-speed impacts.

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.

c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.

c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.

a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.

c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.

Aber ich glaube dass Firaxis sich selber in die Ecke gedribbelt hat, weil jedes Civ muss noch größer, noch komplexer, noch schöner werden. Aber an die notwendigen Brüche trauen sie sich verständlicherweise nicht ran. Zum Beispiel ist Multiplayer mit dem synchronen Rundenmodus einfach ein Graus. Ja, es geht, aber vor allem in der Moderne  spielt sich das zäh wie Teer. Die Hexfelder machen die Karte viel logischer, und die Steuerung viel träger. In der Zeit wo ich in Civ 5 einen Zug mache, mache ich in Civ 2 fünf Züge. Diplomatie und KI wären eigentlich wichtige Faktoren, kommen aber mit der Spielkomplexität nicht klar. Civ braucht einen Neuanfang, vielleicht unter anderem Namen.

At the beginning of the MV, We see In Guk wearing a broken watch. Then he is at a funeral hall, sees Jaehyun, and hides from him. That's when the butterfly crosses his face. In the next cut, we see Jaehyun covering the photo of the deceased and coming out, meeting Inguk, getting his phone number and staying in touch. We understood this much.
Later in the workplace scene, we can see that Jaehyun shows his empty hand to Inguk, meaning, he told him that he is divorced. Then we see them two drinking and walking in the tunnel under the train. That's when Inguk decides to be bold and finally confesses his feelings. He hugs him and waits for Jaehyun to hug him (symbolically asking him to like him back) which he doesn't. That is it. The actual story ends there.
Inguk dies after that incident with Jaehyun under the train in the tunnel.
later, When Jaehyun attends Inguk's funeral, he is filled with regret and imagines changing how he behaved towards Inguk when he was still alive. Inguk is no more but Jaehyun still wonders that had he not asked Inguk's number and stayed in touch with him, the tunnel scene and Inguk's death wouldn't have happened. So he imagines not asking Inguk for his phone number after the funeral and just letting him go so that both of them can live. This was the last scene.
So, to conclude, Inguk is dead and Jaehyun regrets it so badly that he imagines what-ifs and situations where he could've ignored Inguk and made him live by not staying in touch. 
He wears Inguk's watch as the last sign of their friendship and continues to live hoping that he could go back in time and just unmeet Inguk.

I AM CRYING AS I TYPE THIS.

Another possible way of interpreting this is that Inguk was dead from the beginning and it was all Jaehyun's imagination. He knew about his best friend falling for him but couldn't reciprocate the feeling so he didn't do anything. He's feeling guilty cuz he didn't do anything and that's why he imagines a whole scenario of meeting Inguk's soul at his funeral, Imagining him as an existing and alive being ( well, based on how startled Inguk was when Jaehyun offered him a drink whilst sitting beside him. Inguk's reaction was basically "how are you able to see me?") and exchanging contacts with him. The meaning behind him having a Blackberry represents how he is stuck in time and Inguk having an iPhone represents how much Jaehyun wants Inguk to live so that he is living in the present and utilizing technology just like every person alive and living in the moment. So, in conclusion, Inguk is dead and never existed in this MV. Inguk's presence alone was Jaehyun's imagination and he created scenarios. 
The broken watch that Inguk was wearing says a lot about him being already dead and his soul just lingering around cuz we can see that his time ends at 12 on the watch. Jaehyun mends it and keeps it with him as an item of remembrance and thus, there's  24 shown, which means he's still living in deep regret.
This is an alternate interpretation in case anyone disagrees.

Rules:
1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.
2: If you hear a security guard near you hide immediately.

4: You need to be asleep by 2am.


❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.


Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

LOAD marked the biggest change for METALLICA after THE BLACK ALBUM. After its massive success, the rock world had changed, with grunge and alternative rock taking much of the attention. They moved even further away from thrash metal, exploring hard rock, blues, southern rock, and a much more relaxed sound. They also changed their image and the way they presented themselves, adapting to the new rock scene without losing their identity. During this period, they were also sharing stages with bands from grunge, alternative rock, and nu metal.
.
Tracks like THE HOUSE JACK BUILT show how far they had moved from their thrash metal roots. The songs are slower, more melodic, and more focused on groove and atmosphere, but there is still plenty of weight. BLEEDING ME and THE OUTLAW TORN alone show how far they were willing to push themselves creatively, and for me, they are two of the greatest songs of their entire career.
.
What makes LOAD interesting is that they didn't simply make a softer version of THE BLACK ALBUM. They went much further and accepted the risk of disappointing fans who wanted the old sound back. Personally, I've always found it much easier to enjoy than THE BLACK ALBUM and RELOAD. More than 25 years later, I still think it's one of the most interesting and underrated chapters of their career.

Как можно было сделать Сталкер 2 главным разочарованием года? Игра обьективно имеет достаточно проблем, но и много хороших сторон. При чем как можно говорить о том, что сюжет вторичен, не пройдя игру до конца? Ведь он действительно не вторичен и является главным плюсом этой игры. Широкая нелинейность, классные катсцены, конфликты идеологий, очень зашла сюжетная ветка Полдня (бывшего Монолита), плюс сюжет очень много нового вносит в лор игры и обьясняет много непонятных моментов прошлых частей (не без реткона, конечно). Локации в игре под конец действительно пустоваты, но в игре все равно много активностей помимо прохождения квестов. Если тебе не интересно иследовать карту второго Сталкера, то это потому что тебе впринципе не очень интересна эта вселенная. При чем опять эти тейки про фаркрай в постсоветском стиле. В чем сталкер 2 напоминает фаркрай? Тем что там тоже можно стрелять и бегать по открытому миру? Ну так по этим же критериям можно и старые части фаркраями назвать. Так же очень много претензий к багам, которые уже пофиксили (хотя это не оправдание ужасному состоянию игры на старте). И я не хочу назвать сталкер игрой года. Во второй половине игры все побочные активности почти пропадают, A-Life всё ещё уступает прошлым частям, в помещениях освещение просто блевотное, очень мало доп. квестов, баланс тоже оставляет желать лучшего. Игра (в данном состоянии) на 7 из 10, но называть её главным разочарованием - неправильно.

Мне кажется что всё довольно очевидно. Важно рассматривать монстров по отдельности. Хагги, как говорилось в одной из записей, по способностям практически не отстаёт от прототипа, но в то же время его легко подчинить своей воле, и он крайне послушный. Вполне вероятна теория, что он действительно банально на нас охотился. Как и сказал Князич. Всё в его поведении выдает голодного зверя. С Мамочкой всё куда сложнее. Она явно не такая обезумевшая зверюга, как Хагги. Из всех основных монстров, она - единственный, кто до сих пор разговаривал с игроком. Она разумна, она держит под контролем всю игровую станцию. Её целью было не то чтобы тупо убить героя. Она хотела развлечься, и прямо об этом говорила. Возможно она вообще не собиралась никого убивать, и единственной причиной, по которой она напала на нас, стало то, что мы фактически сжульничали в последней игре. Хотя она наверняка хотела нашей смерти, учитывая то, с каким разочарованием она поздравляла нас с победами в играх. А ещё её это дико бесило, так как каждого, кто не смог нас убить, она подвешивала на своей паутине. В общем, я считаю, что ей двигала не жажда насытиться, а банально садистские наклонности, и то, что она слетела с катушек в конце, явно не входило в её планы. Она не собиралась марать об нас руки. Она хотела убить нас руками других. Кот дремот. Он охотник. Но он тоже не стремиться набивать брюхо. Одна из катсцен ближе к концу продемонстрировала, что вместо крупненькой добычи вроде нас он предпочитает мелкие игрушки. Он скинул нас в пресс, потому что не сочел нас за угрозу. Просто какой-то дурак спустился, чего с ним возиться? Вот и скинул в мусоропровод. Он явно не ожидал того, что мы спасемся и выберемся. Это можно понять по тому, как он беззаботно потом выбирался по трубам из мусорки. Увидев же нас живыми и поняв, что мы представляем угрозу его "храму", он, разумеется, начал за нами охоту. Как и Хагги, наблюдал за нами, запугивал, лишал веры в победу, но до последнего не хотел убивать. Даже лично нас предупредил и дал шанс! Возможно потому что понимал, что если мы до сих пор живы, то прототипу, его Богу, это выгодно. Но под конец, когда мы уже почти достигли своей цели, он разумеется забил тревогу. Он не мог допустить того, чтобы мы попали ниже, явно в место, где живет его божество. Он наверняка узнал о судьбе Мисс Приятность, да и Мамочки в целом, что ему мешало просто подняться по быстрому всякими потайными ходами на игровую станцию и понять, что паучихи нигде нет? А не добил он нас потому, что его бог воззвал его к себе. Наверняка он понимал, что проиграл. И с этим позором жить не хотел, потому отдал свою жизнь прототипу. Прототип же тянул к нему руку, предлагая помощь, но Котик не дал ему лапу. Хотя уже явно собирался. Но в последний момент изменил решение, решив раз и навсегда отплатить своему спасителю за, собственно, спасение. Не благодарите)) Форточку уже открыла

Insofern kann man sehen, wie einflussreich das Spiel bis heute ist. Wahrscheinlich eines der top 3 Spiele, mit denen ich die meisten Stunden verbracht habe (die Spielzeit-Anzeige von steam gab's damals noch nicht, liebe Kinder...).Zum Thema Handbuch: hatte man i.d.R. nicht, da alle Spiele Raubkopien waren. Bei TIE Fighter hatte ich mal die 100ste Kopie des Handbuchs, das war aber extrem selten. Da es weder In-Game-Tutorials noch YT-Videos gab, hat man einfach ewig im Spiel mit ausprobieren zugebracht, bis man eine Mechanik verstanden hatte (da man keine so große Auswahl hatte, hatte man mehr Geduld). Tatsächlich macht das aber auch ein Stück weit den Reiz dieser alten Spiele aus. Habe mich deshalb bei manchen Spielen mittlerweile bewusst dazu entschieden, mir vorher keine Videos von anderen Spielern mehr anzuschauen, um diese "Phase des Entdeckens" nicht zu verlieren. Ich will gar nicht mehr wissen, was die beste Strategie ist, um im early game maximale Ressourcen anzuhäufen, sondern lieber mal mit Freude scheitern.

Rules:
1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.

❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.


Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

Спасибо за видео! Я наверное со всем согласен(так как играл только в сталкер 2), в особенности с главным мальчиком года. И хотелось бы написать про сталкер 2. Играя в него на релизе я был разочарован (баги, лаги, софтлоки, вытоки памяти из-за чего комп уходит в несколько минутный стан), затем я начал изучать мир и мне зашло, затем я решил всё-таки выполнять задания и идти по сюжету, где-то спустя 100 часов в игре я его прошел. И чё тут скажешь, игра скучная (побочные задания которые некоторые интересные, но большенство это сходи, убей, принеси, и дай бог 2 найдётся хоть каких-то на 1 лагерь), в основном это геймплей тупо ходить с оружием и по головам целить да схроны с 15 патронами для калаша и палкой колбасы при условии что ты потратил кратно больше ресурсов чтоб туда долезть. Сюжет вроде в начале понятен чё, как и куда, затем происходит некая "таинственность и интрига", которая по большому чёту сводит нас к тому что "Ну крч у нас же игра про зону, значит должна закончится на ЧАЭС", ладно бы это нормально объяснялось, но мотивейшен гг мне не понятна абсолютно, после прохождения у меня не было чувства завершонности, первая мысль была "И нахера я это сделал? Зачем? В чём смысл?". Игра в самом конце сюжета превращается тупо в коридорный шутер, так как после определённого события персы затирают "Зона меняется", и розрабы вместо того чтоб как-то продумать этот момент, как-то изменить мир после этого момента, они тупо игру превращают в коридор чтоб у игрока не возник вопрос "А где же эти изменения?". В общем, игра унылое говно, которая редко может предоставить призрачное удовольствие, но по итогу остаётся чувство что ты просто потерял десятки часов своей жизни на какой-то кал. Про отзывы в стиме(83% положительные из 76к отзывов) могу сказать что такую высокую оценку накрутили мои соотечественники(увы), у нас в Украине просто зайди в тик ток и там уже тебе говорят какая класная игра так плюс ко всему этому она ещё й УКРАИНСКАЯ, такое нужно поддерживать(ну в общем ситуация как со "Смутой"), и я думаю что такая оценка просто из-за отношения многих украинцев к этой игре (у меня есть друзья которые и 2 часа не наиграли а уже написали положительный отзыв). С патчами игру вроде чинят, но я когда играл ещё не застал патча 1.1.3, и думал что хотя-бы в 1.1 что-то исправили, я зашел проверить и все изменения что я увидел это иконка тайников на карте цвет поменяла и в целом всё(патч весил 110 гб), игра как паршиво работала так и осталась. Думаю в это игру можно будет нормально поиграть года через 3. Я по прежнему считаю что киберпанк булили не оч заслужено, вот кто действительно такого заслуживает то это сталкер 2. Киберпанк хоть был игрой на релизе с сюжетом(не думаю что в сталкере будут в патчах латать сюжет). Короче пацаны и девчата, не играйте в сталкер 2, вы матерям ещё нужны, придоставте это блогерам, им хоть за это деньги платят.

Хорошо. Ниже — моя авторская теория по сезону Лололошки «Мастерская 47». Это не пересказ, а именно интерпретация и попытка связать скрытые смыслы.ПисатьТеория по сезону Лололошки «Мастерская 47»1. Что такое «Мастерская 47» на самом деле«Мастерская 47» — это не просто локация и не просто организация.Это экспериментальная зона по переписыванию реальности, где проверяется, насколько далеко можно зайти в управлении мирами, персонажами и самими наблюдателями.Число 47 — не случайно. Оно символизирует:не первый и не последний эксперимент;стабильную, но опасную итерацию;мир, который уже «исправляли», но он всё ещё нестабилен.2. Роль ЛололошкиЛололошка в этом сезоне — не герой и не обычный участник.Он — ключевая переменная, которую нельзя полностью контролировать.Моя теория:Лололошка — персонаж, способный нарушать сценарий, даже если сам этого не осознаёт.Именно поэтому:ему дают свободу действий;его не «выключают», даже когда он мешает;вокруг него постоянно возникают сбои, странные диалоги и поломки логики мира.3. Кто управляет МастерскойСоздатели Мастерской — это не злодеи в классическом смысле.Это архитекторы реальностей, которые считают, что:миры — это проекты;личности — расходный материал;ошибки допустимы, если эксперимент продолжается.Но в «Мастерской 47» что-то пошло не так:мир начал осознавать себя;NPC ведут себя слишком «живыми»;прошлые версии реальности оставили следы.4. Mein Bruder und ich haben damals den ersten Teil auf dem Amiga 500 gespielt. Das waren noch Zeiten. Man sollte auch bedenken, dass das Spiel auf ein paar Floppy-Disks passen musste. D. h., auf dem Amiga war das Spiel etwas weniger als 3,5 MB(!) groß. Viele Grafiken wurden als simple Bitmaps generiert, da das oft einfacher und platzsparender war als heutige Bilder, denn die Grafikformate der damaligen Zeit waren groß und ineffizient. Der Soundtrack bestand auf dem Amiga aus Tracker-Musik. Was damals weitverbreitet war, und ebenfalls sehr platzsparend. Außerdem war der Code damals relativ simpel, da gab es kein Multithreading oder irgendwelchen Internetkram oder sowas, und RAM war damals knapp, sodass man sich nicht einfach wie eine Sau am Trog bedienen konnte, wie man das heute machen kann.

Rules:
1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.

❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.

Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

Full honestly though, the first hour is a little hard as it drags a bit and takes a while to get into it, but the further you watch, the further it draws you in. I completely forgot that I was watching the Youtuber Markiplier - this is the actor, the filmmaker. The film really sucks you in the more you watch, I was invested in Simon and really anxious to see the story unfold and what would happen to him. You'll be gripping your seat due to the intensity in some of the scenes towards the end! I think it's an astounding achievement by Mark. There must have been so many hurdles along the way to finally get this project out. He deserves recognition for the work he and his team must have put in to this after a difficult journey. I really hope the movie does well and as many people as possible go and see it.

 왜그러냐며 화를냄. 왜냐하면 과거 그 안에서 키스사건과 더불어, 자신의 마음을 전했던 곳이었기 때문임.

На мой взгляд, лучшей экранизацией Слендера всё ещё являются "Мраморные шершни". Да в них довольно много нелепостей (лично меня постоянно смешит гг Джей своей тупости и отсутствием инстинктом самосохранения), клише и интерактива (доп канал totheark буквально создан для разгадывания шифров и загадок). Но чего не отнять у Шершней так это персонажей и их нарастающей шизы. При чем сделано это очень грамотно. Сначала Джей пишет, что ему в последнее время не здоровиться. Головная боль, кашель, бессонница. Он ходит к врачу, но тот ничего не находит. Далее он начинает как одержимый смотреть кассеты. Не ест, не спит. Он понимает, что у него провалы память, как старые, таки и новые. Потом он начал снимать себя, в надежде что-то поймать. Преследуюся паранойя, амнезия. И вот когда он перестает это делать, ему немного лучше. Однако обстоятельства вынуждают его снова начать своё расследование и он снова испытывает всё выше перечисленное. В довершение ты начинаешь думать, что единственный способ это остановить, покончить с носителями Слендера. Всё это отлично показано и это веришь. Плюс создатели постарались с временными линиями. Высчитывали дни, время суток, когда публиковать, порой даже отправлялись в опреденые места, чтобы написать сообщение. Ну и ещё сериал неплохо показал концепцию, что Слендер как болезнь. По факту как шизофрения, только передающаяся. Отличным примером, как мне кажется, это Джессика. Она изначально вообще не имела никакого отношения ни к съемочной группе, ни к гг, ни к Слендеру. Она была соседкой девушки Алекса и просто поинтересовалась, куда пропала её подруга. Но случайно Джей затощил её в эту историю (из-за действий Алекса) и вот она тоже под влиянием Слендера.

It understands the context and everything that went into it, not just taking it as face value.I personally loved it so much, (I’m not a mega fan of markiplier, I’ve only watched some of his videos) and I think it’s amazing. I wished they would’ve put more in the movie about Simon’s origins, or what the “answer” was that he saved at the end, but the later i believe was not talked about a lot by design.I felt really excited most of the time, it felt a little slow in the middle but it payed off in the end. My heart was racing the final climax and (spoiler warning) in Simon’s last moments alive I cried a couple little tears. The atmosphere was beyond incredible, and the stakes felt really big to me. I really thought Simon was gonna survive after all of that, but he went out with bravery. After being completely broken and messed up in his head, he still did everything he could in his last moments to do the right thing to save humanity, despite how horribly he was treated. I was in shock and awe especially in that one scene where it looked like the shuttle was split in half and everything was in slow motion, I had to hold my breath it was so tense!All in all, I loved it so much and despite being not a huge fan of markiplier It’s one of my new favorite movies.At face value? 8/10but in my own opinion to me, especially considering the context of how the film was made, it’s a 10/10. We need more movies like this, with passion and fire.

Немного недоработаная теория, но что если прототипу нужны не тела монстров, а наше тело? Если обратиться внимание на то что каждый раз в конце он не убивает нас, хотя вполне может это  сделать, а в третий части так вообще спасает, то само самой наклевывается ощущение будто мы нужны ему, но получается не конкретно мы, а наше тело. На протяжении всей игры, он следит, изучает, делает выводы, в конце, мне кажется, если нам не удастся его убить, то он сможет перенестись в наше тело. По записям же сказано, что прототип умен. Понимаю, тогда возникает вопрос: а чего же он не оставил одного из работников в живых и не воспользовался им? Но тут как раз таки все очевидно. Прототип смог взять монстров под контроль и устроить час радости, но полного контроля он не добился, посему погибли все, кто находился в здании. Поэтому появление главного героя, живого, привело к желание заполучить его тело. Однако, так как прототип умен, ему не нужен слабак не способный справится со всеми этими созданиями, с фабрики же еще нужно сбежать. Почему он отправляет нам монстров, начиная так сказать, с самого простого. Послушного, которого легко подчинить своей воли, Хагги вагги. С ним мы справляемся с легкостью, тогда то прототип отправляет нам сбрендевшую мамашу, которая и сама не прочь поиздеваться над нами, ожидая что мы погибнем, но нет. Мы снова выигрываем. Прототип делает выводы и отправляет нас к самому сильному и послушному, но так как ему все еще необходимо тело, кот нас не убивает, а отправляет на самое первое испытание, в пресс. В конце же, прототип довольный всем что мы прошли, спасает нас от кота, сам прекрасно понимаю, что мы умрем, ведь тот даже мамочки сильнее. К чему я это все: мне кажется что прототип ждет нас, чтобы заполучить тело. Ему нужно выбраться с оболочки этой руки. Знаю много дыр, недоработано и тд, но по мне это самое логичное, почему мы до сих пор живы.

You know that the campaign will have had plot holes, the DM might have fudged some dice roles to keep the momentum going or "safe" the players from a total party kill - but in the end - you had a fun campaign. That's how I felt after many adventures playing RPGs for forty years now and I never looked back at "what if" or "what about x" moments. You enjoyed the moment and you look forward to the next adventure (like Holly's game group).

O Agente Secreto consegue traduzir a alma brasileira na tela, um feito e tanto. O roteiro combina, de maneira orgânica, questões entranhadas na nossa sociedade. Estão lá a corrupção, a mistura do público e privado, a violência, as desigualdades sociais, mas também a doçura, o afeto, a solidariedade, o sexo livre e a alegria de viver do brasileiro. E a resistência ao totalitarismo. Todos os inúmeros personagens do filme são ricos, cativantes, únicos.  Um ano após Ainda Estou Aqui, o cinema brasileiro produz outra obra-prima. É possível um raio cair 2 vezes no mesmo lugar? Para quem possui cineastas como Kleber Mendonça e Walter Salles e atores como Wagner Moura e Fernanda Torres sim, é possível. Mesmo tendo lido muito a respeito e visto os trailers, o filme me surpreendeu e as cenas finais me emocionaram, o que não aconteceu nos outros filmes do Kleber. Wagner Moura tem uma presença cênica absurda, magnética. Dá vontade de entrar na tela e conviver com o mundo retratado no filme. O trabalho de cenografia, som, fotografia,  edição, tudo é feito com um cuidado extremo. Há também a questão da preservação de nossa memória, algo essencial para nos mantermos íntegros. Imprevisível, engraçado, desconcertante, emocionante, surpreendente, O Agente Secreto merece todas as láureas recebidas e as que, porventura, receba. É um filme para ser apreciado várias vezes, se possível. Tomara que faça tanto sucesso quanto Ainda Estou Aqui.

Rules:

❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.


Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.

Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.

a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.

c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.

b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.
