Du sagst, aus heutiger Sicht mag uns das Spiel wie aus der Steinzeit erscheinen. Das ist relativ. Für mich markiert dieses Spiel den Beginn der Moderne der Computerspiele, denn Civilization ist in keiner Weise mehr mit den schnelllebigen und einfachen Spiele etwa für den C64 oder den Atari aus den 80er Jahren zu vergleichen. Man konnte monatelang in der Spielwelt versinken, das war für mich neu. Ich, der damit aufgewachsen bin und für den es damals die Offenbarung schlechthin gewesen ist, spiele es auch heute noch mit Gewinn. Ich mag den experimentellen Stil, die Liebe zum Detail und die makabren Scherze, die Entwicklern heute oft verlorengegangen zu sein scheinen, denn manchmal wirken die heutigen Spiele erschreckend gleichförmig, brav und austauschbar. Und ja, das Frustrationserlebnis, gleich auf Anhieb zu verlieren, wenn man Pech hatte, gehörte damals dazu. Die Spieler wurden noch nicht vor Frustrationen aller Art geschützt und in jeder Phase des Spiels bei der Hand genommen. Das war aber auch gut so, denn so konnte noch echte Begeisterung entstehen, wenn man es endlich geschafft hatte. Auf Massenkompatibilität und Frustrationsvermeidung wurde verzichtet, das fachte den Ehrgeiz der Spieler an. Ebenfalls positiv war die fehlende politische Korrektheit, was den Humor zuweilen zynisch und schwarz erscheinen ließ, aber genau das kam an, zeigte Wirkung und machte mit den Reiz des Spiels aus.

I got all the “feels” during the show … but have been feeling very let down on reflection.  I keep wondering how things would’ve ended absent COVID delays and how long it took them to go from season to season during pre-COVID times.  Season 4 felt off just because of seeing how the “kids” had aged (and how bad some of those attempts failed) but it felt ok because it felt still felt connected and everyone was able to slip into their characters.  Season 5 was harder to connect with because so much was disjointed from the prior 4 seasons and the inability of the actors to slip into the characters & where things stood out like a sore thumb.- The entire Dr. Kay & military subplot was idiotic.  They could have figured a simple way to connect to season 5 military with the season 4 military, even through exposition to what happened in.  To see Linda Hamilton wasted as Dr. Kay was horrendous.- The revelation that the Upside Down was less relevant to Vecna seemed weird given how central it had always seen to be.  It was also weird how things went from “don’t touch these parts of the ground/wall” to “meh, there’s nothing here to worry about”.  I know it is somehow related to a change in connections with hive-mind but was just … “what?” after how much danger was inherent in season 4.- They couldn’t figure out how to figure out how to get Natalia Dyer/Nancy a decent wig given the amount of time she’s on screen?  The bad wigs were so horrid it you just can’t help but notice them.- I’m not sure how to address Millie Bobby Brown and the 11 disconnect.  11 has a distinct way of talking in terms of how/what she says and how she speaks.  I blame 11’s sudden (?) ability to more fully express things but Millie was 98% not connected to the speech patterns she developed for 11.  Like Nancy’s wigs … it was highly distracting.- The only truly rewarding parts of the ending wrap-up segments were Hopper talking to Mike about the choice between holding on to loss or choosing to live the best life forward moving on and the final campaign & how Mike wrapped things up.  Nancy & Co. on the rooftop was … meh.  Hopper & Joyce getting engaged … nice but OK.I’d love to see what was in the show’s Bible when originally pitched which would/should have covered the 5 season pitch with story & character arcs and how closely things aligned.I’d also love to know when each actor had their final moment in filming.  IIRC, there are mini-celebrations when primary actors wrap.  There are so many moments that jump out as possibilities but how did they recognize the work of the individuals who breathed life into these characters for so long?

Sir Matt was a simple man, doing his best to serve the people and create a strong foundation for the generations to come. His son, Sir Gordon on the other hand, was rumoured to be connected to deities, unlocking powers mortals could only dream of. He often finding himself in realms he shouldn't be in, taking great risks to ensure future prosperity. Sir Ryan took what his father had created, and pushed further into cultivating the field of magic. However, cockiness would eventually get the best of him as he was cut down trying to follow his father's path. His son quickly proceeded him. While Sir Timothy rejected his father's ideas around magic, preferring to fight with strength instead of intellect, his father's endeavours had forever cursed him with bright blue skin. However, this did not phase him as he was colourblind, and everyone was too afraid to tell him. Lady Jenny was a compassionate woman. Open hearted to a fault, she was notoriously vegan. While a highly skilled combatant, this would tragically be her downfall, when she accidently consumed chicken during battle, signalling the beginning of the end. Sir Marshall brought about a new era for the family, fuelled by resilience, determination and chicken broth. A humble chef by trade, he bravely took up the mantle of his mother, despite his vision impairment. To everyone's surprise, years of kneading dough had equipped him with an incredible strength, allowing him push further into the dungeon than anyone before him. He was the first to reach Estuary Lamech, charging bravely into battle. But his vision would ultimately get the better of him, as he simply could not see his enemies attacks. Lady Ashley continued the lined with similar ambition. She continued her father's legacy and once again made great strides into the dungeon, being the first to discover Axis Mundi. The land pushed her to dark places, trading parts of her soul for items in the hope of continuing forward. One such item saved her life, practically resurrecting her from the dead (this item has still not been recovered). However, even defying death could not changer her lack of swimming abilities, and she drowned attempting to cross the lake. A unclimactic end for such a hero. Lady Jenny II was seemingly cursed from the beginning. While as compassionate as her great grandmother, she suffered terrible vertigo and often found herself disorientated. She accepted her fate admirably, taking her last stand in the gauntlet that would ultimately be her end. This would end the Age of Chefs. While not a chef, Lady Meg would continue the progress brought about by her great grandfather. Despite being a highly skilled fighter, she was exceptionally paranoid, and developed an obsession with chicken at a young age. She was the second the face Estuary Lamech. Lady Emily was undoubtedly the greatest warrior the family ever saw. Cunning, agile, and highly resourceful, she had a natural gift for swordplay and quickly outwitted anyone who faced her. However, few knew that she had suffered a vampire attack, cursing her with frail skin, soulless eyes and a thirst for blood. When she made her way into the dungeon, she effortlessly pushed forward, becoming more powerful than ever. She was the third and last to reach Lamech, putting him out of his misery forever. She tragically lost her life fighting a gauntlet, putting an end to her remarkable tale. To this day, she stands as a testament to the heights such a family can reach. Sir Mauricio continued the vampiric bloodline, but his reign would mark the downfall of the bloodline. His strengths could not outweigh his weaknesses as a vampire, and he perished quickly, uneventfully. Lady Meg II continued the downwards trend. While a chef by trade, she was excessively greedy, trading more and more of her soul as she pushed in Axis Mundi. As more and more risks were taken, her life grew ever weaker, before she was eventually killed in the pursuit of yet more treasure. Sir Trumam would usher in the lowest point in the families history. Often nicknamed "Jim" despite not having a first name, he had a crippling fear of water due to his father tragically dying during a fishing accident. This only worsened as he continued into the dungeon, nearly drowning at multiple stages, before dying at the hands of a single enemy. Sir Truman II was incredibly unexceptional. Known for his over confidence and "edginess", he perished quickly in the dungeon. He is often forgotten to history. Sir Truman II (the second) began with potential. A skilled gunsmith, he was the first to create what is now known as a flintlock pistol. However, he suffered severe anxiety and would break down at the slightest hit. Despite this, his push started well, before once again, he fell into the trap of his fore fathers. Sacrificing part of his soul, his weapon slowed to a crawl, sacrificing any tactical advantage. Due to his grandfather's fear, he was never taught to swim, and after surviving multiple near death drowning, it was eventually too much and he perished. So ended the "Jim Carrey" legacy.

Rules:
1: Always stay with one of your friends and never be alone.

❤️: You died!
💛: You made a bad choice, but you survived.
💚: You’re safe… for now.


Context: You are outside at about 7:30pm with your friends Samantha and Hailey. You are shopping at your local mall and it is almost closing time. Hailey brings up an idea to try to stay after hours at the mall. You are too scared to do it but Hailey is your only ride home.

#1: The final closing announcement is heard in the store you are in. If you don't want to get caught you have to hide. Which store are you hiding in?

a) Sephora
b) Hair Salon
c) Clothing Store


........................................


a) ❤️: There wasn't enough space for you and your friends to hide, and you got caught. You were killed by your parents.
b) 💛: You hid with all the supplies in the break room, but were very close to being found.
c) 💚: You were safe because you and your friends hid in clothing racks during closing.



#2: After all the security guards left you needed to find food because you and your friends were hungry. You walk into a candy shop and grab some things you like. What do you do next?

a) Make it look like someone robbed the store at night and you left without paying.
b) Leave a $10 bill which is more than enough to pay for the things you took.
c) Grab only a little bit of candy so the owner doesn't notice anything and leave.


............................................................................


a) ❤️: The security guard hears the commotion and finds you and your friends.
b) 💚: Your sense of decency saved you and your friends from whatever consequences would have come if you hadn't paid.
c) 💛: You are safe for the night and nobody is hurt. For now...


#3: Hailey gets a notification on her phone that is from her mother. You three have to make up a lie that will save all of you from your parents. What do you do?


a) Tell Hailey's mom that you will be back in the morning and that you are sleeping over at another friend's house.
b) Tell Hailey's mom you were sleeping over at Samantha's house for the night.
c) Ignore the text.

...............................................................................


a) 💛: You were close to death, but luckily Hailey's mom is very chill, so she didn't ask any follow-up questions.
b) ❤️: Her mom wasn't questioning anything, but texted Samantha's mom to ask how the girls were doing. You all were killed the next day.
c) 💛: Close call on ignoring her, but she just thought you were busy and didn't ask anything again.


#4: It's getting late and you made a pile of clothes to sleep on that are hidden away. Samantha can't sleep and Hailey's snoring is preventing you from sleeping. What do you do?

a) Relax a bit and try to sleep again.
b) Stay awake and scroll on your phone.
c) Walk around the different stores and leave your friends in the clothing store.


......................................................................


a) 💚: You ended up fast asleep in 2 minutes, and so did Samantha, you are safe tonight.
b) ❤️: A security guard saw the light from your phone and took you all into the jail under the mall.
c) ❤️: You died because a mysterious figure attacked you and nobody was there to help you.


#5: It is around 4:45 am and you hear a loud bang. Somehow only you wake up and everyone else is fast asleep. You decide to wake up your friends and explore the sound. What do you do next?


a) You go downstairs to the main area where you can see almost everywhere on the first floor.
b) You each separate and go into different stores searching for the source of the noise.
c) You stay on the second floor and explore quietly making sure everyone is safe.


...................................................................


a) ❤️: Staying in the main area leaves you open to anything around you including security guards.
b) ❤️: Welp you died, never go alone in a horror game/movie.
c) 💛: This is the best option even though it is quite dangerous to leave your spot in general. Staying together is good.


#6: You and your friends figure out the sound was caused by a bookshelf falling in the bookstore, but you were seen by a security guard after figuring this out. What do you do?

a) Run.
b) Hide.
c) Throw books at the security guard.


......................................................


a) 💛: You got away but you were out of breath and Samantha had trouble turning on the car which led to a close chase with the guard.
b) 💚: You hid in one of the aisles and the security guard got confused and ran out of the store looking for you.
c) 💛: The books slowed the security guard down, but they made him angrier. You still managed to escape.
